purpose: Stage-specific reference pair for the Amiga OCS Portrait v1 house style.

target_examples.role: human review target; never sent to img2img

generation_prompt.intent: Create a clean pre-quantisation portrait master for later reduction through the deterministic OCS renderer.
generation_prompt.composition: Square head-and-shoulders portrait with the subject inside a central 28:23 safe area and eyes near 42 percent from the top.
generation_prompt.rendering: Broad connected tonal shapes, deliberate edges, no more than five visible value steps per material, and minimal microtexture.
generation_prompt.lighting: Quiet upper-left key light with warm skin planes and cool reflected shadows.
generation_prompt.palette_direction: Muted charcoal, umber, rust, ochre, parchment, moss, and slate blue.
generation_prompt.avoid: Visible pixels, dithering, checker patterns, scanlines, CRT effects, text, borders, card frames, UI, props, and invented narrative elements.
